summaryEn: Musk discusses Norway's world-leading electric-vehicle adoption and the role of incentives in an interview with the Norwegian EV Association.
summaryZh: 马斯克在接受挪威电动汽车协会采访时，讨论了挪威世界领先的电动汽车普及率以及激励措施所发挥的作用。

segments.textEn: it will happen even further so we will have a paradigm shift and a total disruption on a global level because Norway did this even though the technology was not really mature we have mostly been the in the beginning of that when the sales started running there were still cars with low low range with lack charging stations in other countries you will be helped with better technology cars that can go with long range and and better charging infrastructure so that's why I'm saying this will probably happen faster in many other markets as should as soon as we reach this tipping point where the price levels out and of course it will happen even sooner in markets where the politicians are helping with incentives and trying to push this to happen faster
segments.textZh: 这种情况甚至会进一步发展，因此我们将迎来一次范式转变，以及全球层面的彻底颠覆，因为挪威做到了这一点，尽管当时技术其实并不成熟。我们基本上从一开始就身处其中；当销量开始增长时，仍然有续航很低很低的汽车，也缺少充电站。在其他国家，你们将得到更先进技术的帮助，汽车能够拥有长续航，还有更完善的充电基础设施。所以我才说，一旦我们达到价格趋于持平的这个临界点，这种情况在许多其他市场可能会发生得更快；当然，在政界人士通过激励措施提供帮助并努力推动这一进程更快发生的市场，它会发生得更早。
